methods.01_damped_phase: Half-step phase refresh to suppress oscillation
methods.02_inner_phase: Solve phase consistency inside each position evaluation
methods.03_regional_basins: RF-ranked regional multistart across the 25 km box
methods.04_receiver_shrink: Reduce nonlinear receiver smooth prior SD 200 to 50 Hz
methods.05_orbit_shrink: Halve all physical orbital-mode prior standard deviations
methods.06_age_uncertainty: Add independent phase uncertainty of one second per 24 h TLE age in quadrature
methods.07_shared_rate: Add one Gaussian satellite-shared frequency rate, SD 0.5 Hz/s
methods.09_joint_families: Joint replacement of primary and a conflicting/influential secondary family
methods.10_gate_margin: Constrained fit with 0.05 normalized slack margin

catalogue: latest causal elements available by scan cutoff, <=72h; no later TLEs
selection: paired RF scores within each variant, unchanged observations; retain all published owners; GPS only for reporting
scope: four posthoc outliers, controlled mechanism prototypes; not promotion evidence
